name: Vault Notes
description: Offline-capable reference notes module exposing governed extension points under Modula Module Standard 2.1.

permissions.reason: Create and update account-scoped Vault Notes records.
Trash, restore and permanently delete account-scoped Vault Notes records.
Publish account-scoped search projections for notes and folders.
Emit redacted Vault Notes lifecycle events.

capabilities.reason: Persist notes, folders, tags, links, versions and saved-source references.
Expose declarative note, folder and tag actions.
Describe function metadata and side effects.
Use host generic migrations when needed.
capabilities.degradedBehavior: Vault Notes remains uninstallable until host generic record support is available.

capabilities.reason: Import portable Markdown, plain text, and Vault backups.
capabilities.degradedBehavior: Import remains available only through module helpers.

capabilities.reason: List and restore immutable note checkpoints.
capabilities.degradedBehavior: Writes remain revision-safe but history cannot be browsed through the host.

capabilities.reason: Declare offline intent without claiming a sync runtime.
Adopt a future generic cursor and tombstone contract.
Expose quick capture and note collections after a generic widget registry exists.
